title: No Water / Long Freeze
shortDescription: Freeze cycle did not complete due to no/low water or thermistor not satisfied.
fullDescription: On Prodigy Plus, one flash of the diagnostic LED indicates a freeze cycle that exceeded its time limit. Causes include water supply issues, scale on evaporator, dirty condenser, or low refrigerant.

fixSteps.title: Verify water supply
fixSteps.instruction: Confirm 20-80 psi dynamic pressure and clean inlet strainer.

fixSteps.title: Descale
fixSteps.instruction: Run Scotsman ice machine cleaner cycle.

fixSteps.title: Clean condenser
fixSteps.instruction: Brush and vacuum the condenser fins.

whenToCallPro: Refrigerant and compressor work require an EPA-certified technician.

faq.q: How do I read flash codes?
faq.a: Watch the diagnostic LED count between pauses; the manual lists code definitions.

title: Long Harvest Cycle
shortDescription: Harvest cycle exceeded its time limit.
fullDescription: Two flashes indicate harvest did not complete within the maximum time. Scotsman flake/cube models rely on hot-gas defrost; if the slab won't release, this code sets after multiple attempts.

fixSteps.title: Descale
fixSteps.instruction: Run cleaner cycle thoroughly. Inspect evaporator surface afterward.

fixSteps.title: Test hot-gas valve
fixSteps.instruction: Verify coil voltage and replace valve if necessary.

whenToCallPro: Hot-gas valve replacement requires refrigerant recovery.

faq.a: Every 6 months minimum; quarterly in hard water.

title: Water Sensor Issue
shortDescription: Water level sensor invalid or sump fill failure.
fullDescription: Three flashes indicate the water sensor or sump fill is faulty. The unit cannot confirm proper water level for ice making.

fixSteps.title: Clean probes
fixSteps.instruction: Remove and descale water level probes.

fixSteps.title: Test inlet valve
fixSteps.instruction: Check 24V/120V at coil during fill cycle.

whenToCallPro: If valves and probes are good, suspect control board.

faq.a: Yes; they are an inexpensive service part.

title: High Discharge Temperature
shortDescription: Compressor discharge sensor exceeded safe temperature.
fullDescription: Four flashes indicate the discharge temperature has exceeded a safe limit. Same root causes as on other brands: dirty condenser, fan failure, or low charge.

fixSteps.title: Clean condenser
fixSteps.instruction: Vacuum and brush coil; verify ambient and clearances.

fixSteps.title: Test fan
fixSteps.instruction: Verify fan operation and capacitor.

whenToCallPro: Refrigerant work requires EPA certification.

faq.a: Yes; high room temp reduces condenser performance.

title: Bin Thermistor Fault
shortDescription: Bin sensor open, shorted, or out of range.
fullDescription: Five flashes indicate the bin thermistor is reporting an invalid resistance. The unit cannot determine bin level and stops production.

fixSteps.title: Inspect connector
fixSteps.instruction: Check bin thermistor connector for damage.

fixSteps.title: Test thermistor
fixSteps.instruction: Measure resistance and replace if out of spec.

whenToCallPro: If thermistor is good, board may need replacement.

faq.a: Mounted near the bin opening; consult parts diagram for your model.

title: Compressor Thermistor Fault
shortDescription: Discharge or evaporator thermistor invalid.
fullDescription: Six flashes indicate one of the refrigeration thermistors is open or shorted. Without valid temperature data, the control cannot manage cycles.

fixSteps.title: Test thermistors
fixSteps.instruction: Use service mode to read each thermistor and identify the bad one.

fixSteps.title: Replace thermistor
fixSteps.instruction: Install new thermistor with proper thermal contact.

whenToCallPro: Persistent faults after thermistor replacement need board diagnosis.

faq.a: No, use the part number for your specific model.

title: High Pressure Cutout
shortDescription: High-pressure switch tripped repeatedly.
fullDescription: After multiple HP trips, the controller locks out with seven flashes. Causes are blocked airflow, fan failure, overcharge, or non-condensables.

fixSteps.title: Clean condenser
fixSteps.instruction: Thorough coil cleaning and ambient check.

fixSteps.title: Tech diagnosis
fixSteps.instruction: Refrigerant pressures, switch operation, and charge by certified tech.

whenToCallPro: All refrigeration repairs need certified service.

faq.a: Power-cycling clears the lockout, but the underlying cause must be fixed.

title: Purge Valve Stuck
shortDescription: Sump purge valve not operating correctly.
fullDescription: The purge valve dumps mineral-laden water at the end of each cycle. If it sticks open, water continually drains; if stuck closed, scale accumulates rapidly. Some Prodigy Plus models flag this in service mode.

fixSteps.title: Inspect valve
fixSteps.instruction: Disassemble purge valve, clean diaphragm and ports.

fixSteps.title: Replace coil/valve
fixSteps.instruction: Install replacement valve assembly if cleaning fails.

whenToCallPro: If purge valve replacement does not resolve, board may need service.

faq.a: Removes mineral concentration from sump; prevents scale and improves ice quality.

title: Water Curtain Fault
shortDescription: Water curtain switch not changing state during harvest.
fullDescription: The water curtain swings outward to release the ice slab; a magnetic switch confirms the action. If the switch does not toggle, the controller flags WC. Causes include misaligned curtain, weak magnet, or failed switch.

fixSteps.title: Realign curtain
fixSteps.instruction: Confirm hinges free, curtain swings cleanly. Remove any ice buildup.

fixSteps.title: Test switch
fixSteps.instruction: Use service mode or multimeter to verify switch state when curtain moves.

whenToCallPro: If switch and curtain are correct, board may be the issue.

faq.a: Curtain plus magnetic switch confirm slab release for safe cycle progression.

title: Cleaning Reminder
shortDescription: Cleaning interval reached based on runtime.
fullDescription: Prodigy Plus tracks cycles and prompts cleaning. Ignoring it leads to scale-related faults. The unit continues running, so the operator can plan downtime.

fixSteps.title: Run cleaning cycle
fixSteps.instruction: Use approved nickel-safe cleaner per manual.

fixSteps.title: Sanitize
fixSteps.instruction: Run sanitizing cycle after cleaning.

whenToCallPro: Routine cleaning is operator-level; deep service requires a tech.

faq.a: Briefly, but scale accumulates and triggers harvest issues.

title: Water Sensor Fault
shortDescription: Prodigy water sensor not detecting water.
fullDescription: Scotsman Prodigy uses optical/conductive water sensors. The 1L (or amber) light flashes when water is missing or the sensor is dirty.

fixSteps.title: Clean sensor
fixSteps.instruction: Wipe sensor probes with Scotsman cleaner.

fixSteps.title: Check water supply
fixSteps.instruction: Confirm shutoff open and 20+ PSI inlet.

fixSteps.title: Replace sensor
fixSteps.instruction: Swap sensor assembly per service kit.

whenToCallPro: Sealed-system work on Scotsman cubers requires a certified commercial tech. Commercial appliance work in foodservice settings requires a licensed/EPA-certified technician for refrigerant, gas, or high-voltage components.
